research_scope: Scratch Cisco BGP LM only; live source modules treated as read-only
provenance: Original paraphrases of code/fixtures from user's own project; not Cisco documentation text

facts.observation: Local CE AS must differ from each eBGP upstream AS in this IPv4 design.
facts.verify: Compare local router bgp ASN with remote-as neighbor values.
facts.not_proven: An ASN equality check is design validation, not proof of a live FSM failure.

facts.observation: Each CE-to-upstream connection needs valid, distinct local/remote interface addresses and unique CE/peer tuples.
facts.verify: Compare interface addresses, prefixes, neighbor address and interface selection.
facts.not_proven: Configuration form validation does not attest to network transport.

facts.observation: BGP network prefix input is required to be the actual network address in this generator.
facts.verify: Check exact intended prefix and corresponding BGP origination prerequisites.
facts.not_proven: A valid prefix field does not prove advertisement or local RIB eligibility.

facts.observation: For multiple CEs, internal transport, loopback reachability and next-hop resolution may be external prerequisites.
facts.verify: Check internal IGP/static routes, source loopbacks, peer AF and next-hop reachability.
facts.not_proven: A drawn interconnect does not establish iBGP or forwarding state.

facts.observation: Preferred route Local Preference must be greater than backup to express desired outbound preference in the modeled configuration.
facts.verify: Compare effective per-prefix Local Preference after inbound route-maps.
facts.not_proven: It does not guarantee the chosen exit when next hop, route visibility or higher-ranked criteria differ.

facts.observation: BGP maximum-prefix parameter is validated to a positive integer.
facts.verify: Inspect neighbor maximum-prefix policy and observed route count.
facts.not_proven: A count alone does not establish actual session shutdown semantics; options and version matter.

facts.observation: The policy editor rejects Local Preference on export and AS_PATH prepend on import for this BGP design workflow.
facts.verify: Check applied inbound/outbound route-map on correct neighbor/address-family.
facts.not_proven: These UI checks are not universal protocol enforcement across every deployment.

facts.observation: Prefix-scoped policy rules can modify attributes differently from baseline per-link settings.
facts.verify: Compare prefix list entries and route-map match/order on the selected peer.
facts.not_proven: Model policy planning does not prove actual route-map execution on devices.

facts.observation: Under model assumptions available CE-to-ISP paths rank by imported local preference and deterministic tie-break.
facts.verify: Evaluate available model link set and its chosen candidate path.
facts.not_proven: Simulation does not reproduce Cisco complete BGP best-path, packet transit or live convergence.

facts.observation: The simple synthetic observer prefers shorter AS_PATH under assumed equal upstream preference/policy.
facts.verify: Compare exported customer prefix, AS_PATH prepend and which synthetic ISP/CE remains available.
facts.not_proven: Cannot guarantee actual Internet inbound preference or third-party policy.

facts.observation: A CE-owned prefix can lose modeled alternate advertisement when its owner/interconnect fails.
facts.verify: Check CE-owned route separately from shared client LAN advertisement.
facts.not_proven: An independent shared LAN may survive; do not equate route ownership and VRRP gateway.

facts.observation: The synthetic client gateway picks preferred healthy CE, while inbound shared LAN may enter another CE.
facts.verify: Inspect separately the model gateway, outbound, inbound, CE-owned and shared-LAN selections.
facts.not_proven: VRRP timers, tracking, actual VRRP config and physical forwarding are not simulated.

facts.observation: Regression cases cover CE failure, WAN failure, interconnect loss, concurrent failures and restoration.
facts.verify: Compare same topology before failure, during failure and after restoration.
facts.not_proven: A restored synthetic path is not a tested real BGP reconvergence time.

facts.observation: Numeric State/PfxRcd in Cisco summary represents an Established neighbor for this scoped address-family.
facts.verify: Correlate BGP summary with neighbor details, notifications and routes.
facts.not_proven: Route count in a summary is not proof of RIB/FIB installation or service reachability.
